item.title: Jev, and Why Typed-Decision Models Need Their Own Benchmark
item.description: A quick tour of TypeSafe AI’s Jev, why free-form LLM benchmarks don’t measure typed decisions well, and JevBench — a small, paradigm-agnostic benchmark for Choice / Score / Noul decisions.
